perp_dist.description: Perpendicular orthogonal distance from GPS observation to candidate road segment.

proj_ratio.description: Scalar u indicating position of orthogonal projection along segment length.

delta_heading.description: Minimal absolute angular difference between GPS velocity heading vector and arc orientation vector.

arc_length.description: Physical metric length of candidate road segment.

gps_speed.description: Estimated instantaneous speed between consecutive GPS pings.

speed_ratio.description: Ratio of inferred GPS speed to reference urban speed v_ref = 13.8889 m/s (50 km/h).

traversal_rate.description: Segment traversal frequency defined as gps_speed / max(1.0, arc_length).

candidate_rank.description: Spatial proximity rank of candidate among retrieved arcs ordered by perp_dist.

is_adjacent.description: Indicator whether candidate shares a vertex with any top candidate from previous step t-1.

target_description: 1 if candidate arc corresponds to the ground-truth reference segment, 0 otherwise.
training_filter_rule: Filter to is_training_eligible == 1 for binary classifier training to avoid all-negative choice sets.
